title: Generative AI Bootcamp
overview: Dive deep into the world of Generative AI through real-world projects and hands-on training. This bootcamp covers everything from prompt engineering to building AI applications using the latest LLM technologies.
details: Understand the core concepts of Generative AI and large language models (LLMs)
Learn prompt engineering techniques to maximize AI outputs
Build real-time AI chatbots and assistants using OpenAI and HuggingFace
Fine-tune open-source models for specific business or academic use-cases
Deploy AI tools using LangChain, FastAPI, and Gradio

title: IoT & Robotics Camp
overview: Explore the future of connected devices and intelligent machines. This camp introduces students to IoT systems, robotics programming, sensor integration, and automation using real hardware.
details: Learn how IoT devices communicate using sensors and microcontrollers
Build and control robots using Arduino and Raspberry Pi
Integrate AI and machine learning into robotics applications
Monitor data in real-time through dashboards and cloud services
Work on practical projects involving automation and robotics

title: Power BI Mastery Workshop
overview: Gain practical skills in business analytics and data visualization with Microsoft Power BI. This workshop is designed for professionals looking to transform raw data into powerful insights and reports.
details: Connect, clean, and transform data using Power Query
Create professional dashboards and visuals with ease
Master DAX for advanced data modeling and KPIs
Deploy and share interactive reports through Power BI Service
Apply Power BI to real-world business scenarios
